QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] The Power of Wu Tien
QuestInfo.0: Mu Gong says he'll teach you how to tap the vital force of Wu Tien Mountain.
QuestInfo.1: Mu Gong says he'll teach you how to tap the vital force of Wu Tien Mountain.
QuestInfo.2: Following Mu Gong's lesson, you managed to tap the vital force of Wu Tien Mountain. To do so, you had to face your own tenacity in physical form. But you overcame it, of course, and came out even more powerful than before.
